candidates.change_summary: Replace the final transfer to owner with sending the contract balance to the zero address (burn), changing owner balance and thus observable post-call owner funds.
Replace the final transfer to owner with transferring the contract balance to msg.sender, so caller receives remaining balance instead of owner.
Replace the final transfer to owner with sending the contract balance back to the target address, altering which external account receives leftover funds.
Replace the call to target with a low-level call that sends zero value, so target is not forwarded msg.value and contract balance remains different after go.
Replace the external call to target with a call that includes some calldata (non-empty), which may change target behavior and thus leftover balance.
Replace the revert on failed call with ignoring the failure (no revert), allowing different end-state balances when target call fails.
Replace the final transfer with sending the balance using send() and not reverting on failure, which can change observable owner balance if send fails.
Replace the order: transfer contract balance to owner BEFORE calling target, changing whether owner receives funds forwarded to target.
